thoughts.sr: Zvanična mreža je sada 35 min od prijema, dok je mreža građanskih senzora 15 min od prijema i ima 52 instrumenta naspram SEPA-ina 32. Maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 74 na 218 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 55 na 191 µg/m³ između izvorno označenih 01:00 i 02:00, pri čemu je mali model oba pomeranja ocenio sa 5/5 po iznenađenju. [F2][F10][F5][F9][F53]
thoughts.en: The official network is now 35 min from reception, while the citizen network is 15 min from reception and has 52 instruments against SEPA’s 32 [F2][F10]. The PM10 maximum moved from 74 to 218 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 55 to 191 µg/m³ between source-labelled 01:00 and 02:00, both shifts receiving a 5/5 surprise rating from the small model [F5][F9][F53].
hypotheses: Maybe the paired particulate shifts reflect a shared episode, but the source-labelled clock needs correction before timing it [F3][F5][F9].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception preserve Surčin as the station with both particulate maxima [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda uparena pomeranja čestica odražavaju zajedničku epizodu, ali izvorno označen sat treba ispraviti pre njenog vremenskog određivanja [F3][F5][F9].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA prijem zadržati Surčin kao stanicu sa oba maksimuma čestica [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA reception across stations for PM10 and PM2.5, retaining the source-label caveat [F3][F4][F8].

thoughts.sr: SEPA je poslednji put primljen pre 47 min, dok je Sensor.Community poslednji put primljen pre 7 min. Parking Servis prikazuje promenu sa 55 na 335 slobodnih mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac", ali ne daje vreme merenja; Danas ima 12 naslova, Beta 1, RTS 3, a Večernje novosti 1. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F14][F16][F21][F22]
thoughts.en: SEPA was last received 47 min ago, while Sensor.Community was last received 7 min ago [F2][F10]. Parking Servis reports a change from 55 to 335 free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac", but gives no measurement time [F11][F12]; Danas has 12 headlines, Beta 1, RTS 3, and Vecernje novosti 1 [F14][F16][F21][F22].

thoughts.sr: Svežiji prikaz stavlja poslednji prijem SEPA na pre 23 min, a Sensor.Community na pre 13 min. Između sati koje je izvor označio kao 02:00 i 03:00, maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 218 na 149 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 191 na 130 µg/m³, dok se maksimum NO2 pomerio sa 83 na 89 µg/m³. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The fresher view puts SEPA’s last reception at 23 min ago and Sensor.Community’s at 13 min ago [F2][F10]. Across the source-labelled hours 02:00 and 03:00, the PM10 maximum moved from 218 to 149 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 191 to 130 µg/m³, while the NO2 maximum moved from 83 to 89 µg/m³ [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: Perhaps the paired movement of the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima reflects a shared change at the station producing both maxima, while NO2 followed a different spatial pattern [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Will the next labelled hour preserve the shared direction of the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima [F5][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda upareno kretanje maksimuma PM10 i PM2.5 odražava zajedničku promenu na stanici koja proizvodi oba maksimuma, dok je NO2 pratio drugačiji prostorni obrazac [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći označeni sat sačuvati zajednički smer maksimuma PM10 i PM2.5 [F5][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: I would compare the station identities and maxima in the next labelled hour, while retaining the warning that the source labels local time as Z [F3][F4][F6][F8].

The source-labelled movement is recorded, but the label’s relation to true UTC is itself uncertain, so it does not establish when the measured change occurred [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.en: At 04:25 Monday, Sensor.Community and Parking Servis were each received 7 min ago, while SEPA trails at 47 min [F1][F2][F10][F11]. The largest parking-display movement was from 136 to 332 at Garaža "Obilićev venac", but the absent measurement time prevents me from aligning it with the air observations [F11][F12].
hypotheses: Maybe the movement from 136 to 332 reflects a batch refresh rather than a contemporaneous change, since the source supplies no measurement time [F11][F12].
questions: Will the next Parking Servis reception preserve 332 at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda pomeranje sa 136 na 332 odražava paketno osvežavanje, a ne istovremenu promenu, pošto izvor ne daje vreme merenja [F11][F12].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem Parking Servisa zadržati 332 u Garaži "Obilićev venac" [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception with 332 at Garaža "Obilićev venac" and check whether any measurement time appears [F11][F12].

hypotheses: Perhaps the display change reflects an update whose timing the source does not expose.

Prijavljene maksimalne promene predstavljaju poređenja između sati označenih izvorom, a ne dokaz promene u gradu u određenom vremenu. [F3][F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]

The reported maximum changes are comparisons between source-labelled hours, not evidence of a timed change in the city [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: Perhaps the source-label discrepancy explains why the apparent sequence cannot yet be interpreted temporally [F3].
questions: What measurement timestamp, if any, accompanies the SEPA values behind the source labels [F3]?

thoughts.sr: Dodatno pomeranje je kod NO2: njegov maksimum se pomerio sa 89 na 76 µg/m³ između izvorno označenih sati 03:00 i 04:00, ali 04:00 UTC odgovara procenjenom stvarnom UTC vremenu 02:00, pa se još ne može uskladiti sa ponedeljkom u 05:13 po lokalnom vremenu. [F7][F1][F3][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: The additional movement is NO2: its maximum moved from 89 to 76 µg/m³ between the source-labelled hours 03:00 and 04:00 [F7], but 04:00 UTC corresponds to estimated true UTC 02:00, so it cannot yet be aligned with Monday 05:13 local [F1][F3]. Sensor.Community arrived 15 min ago, more recently than SEPA at 35 min, offering a separate stream to test whether the particulate pattern is shared without treating either timestamp as event time [F2][F10].
hypotheses: Perhaps the downward movements in PM10 and PM2.5 maxima will also appear in Sensor.Community once stations and time bases are aligned [F5][F9][F10].
questions: Do overlapping SEPA and Sensor.Community stations show the same direction of particulate movement after their time bases are aligned [F5][F9][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda će se silazna pomeranja maksimuma PM10 i PM2.5 pojaviti i u Sensor.Community kada se stanice i vremenske osnove usklade [F5][F9][F10].
